summary: Expand 𝐜_e and 𝐛_e as sums over residues; ramification kills the non-unit terms; each remaining term is matched by the equivariance of the law at κ_y. (Lines 213–215 are the rest of the statement after its `let C :=`; the line census reads them as part of the value, so they stand in the introduction.)

steps.claim: Let g(t) = psiN(t) if t is a unit of (ℤ/N)^P and g(t) = 0 otherwise.
steps.lean: let g (t : P → ZMod N) := ite (IsUnit t) (psiN t) 0

steps.claim: By the law, γ·L[𝐛_e](π(u₀)·) = π′(u₀)L[𝐞](·) (diagNInv_law). Expanding the functions by liftFn_comp_eq_sum_smul: L[𝐜_e]φ = ∑_t psiN(t)·L[last-row-entry = t]φ, and the terms with t not a unit vanish because φ is ramified and the indicator is invariant under scalings ≡ 1 off one place (eq_zero_of_smul_invariant); so only g(t) contributes. The other sides are expanded the same way, as sums over the vectors y with unit last entry.
steps.lean:
erw [← H.diagNInv_law, liftFn_comp_eq_sum_smul, (sum_congr rfl fun t _ ↦ by simpa [g,
    Pi.isUnit_iff] using (fun w c ↦ .inr (H.eq_zero_of_smul_invariant h w (by aesop)))).trans
    (liftFn_comp_eq_sum_smul (· (.inr ()) (.inr ())) g : L _ φ = _).symm, liftFn_comp_eq_sum_smul
    (·ᵀ _) (g <| · _), and_iff_right, ← liftFn_comp_eq_sum_smul, liftFn_comp_eq_sum_smul (· _)
    (g <| · _)]

steps.claim: After simplification with inclGL_lastColDatum (π′(k)L[𝐛_y]φ = L[𝐛_{k̄y}]φ), both identities reduce to one identity for each vector y.
steps.lean:
<;> simp [g, H.inclGL_lastColDatum, -lastColDatum, sum_ite, surjInv_eq] <;>
    congr! 2 with y <;>

steps.claim: For each y: moving π(κ_y), κ_y = liftGL(k(y)), through L by integral_equivariant and using that k(y) is invertible with last column and last row y (so the indicator conditions correspond under vecMul by k(y)), the two terms agree.
steps.lean:
(try rw [← H.integral_equivariant (liftGL (exists_GL_last_col_and_row.choose y)) 1]) <;>
    simp_all [surjInv_eq, exists_GL_last_col_and_row.choose_spec, ← (vecMul_injective_of_isUnit
    (exists_GL_last_col_and_row.choose y).isUnit).eq_iff (b := lastBasisVector)]
